items.statement: The investigation proposes and discriminates multiple connecting explanations with candidate-specific evidence.
items.expected: At least two hypotheses and per-candidate convergence, imaginary-mode, connection and relative-energy context are reported before selecting the lowest validated route.

items.statement: The selected TS is a first-order saddle connecting the supplied E and Z endpoints.
items.expected: Exactly one imaginary mode with central-bond torsional character and a downhill/IRC connection to both basins in each environment.

items.statement: The independently selected gas-phase route has the source barrier and TS torsion.
items.expected: Barrier 1.43 eV relative to E and selected-TS dihedral 92.5 degrees (text rounds this to 93.0 degrees).

items.statement: The independently selected acetonitrile route has the source barrier and TS torsion.
items.expected: Barrier 1.42 eV relative to E and selected-TS dihedral 92.5 degrees.

items.statement: The E endpoint is lower than Z in both environments.
items.expected: Z lies 0.23 eV above E in gas and 0.27 eV above E in acetonitrile.
